original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚空军在乍得湖地区空袭打死ISWAP头目
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚空军在乍得湖地区实施精确空袭，打死伊斯兰国西非省（ISWAP）多名关键人物，包括该组织安全结构及领导委员会成员。尼日利亚空军公共关系与信息主管称，此次行动在“哈丁凯行动”联合特遣部队框架下针对一处恐怖分子藏身点实施，并摧毁了船只发动机和摩托车等后勤资产。上述战果来自军方单方面声明，属初步评估，目前仅有一个来源，尚未获得独立证实。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚空军在乍得湖地区实施精确空袭，打死ISWAP多名关键人物
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Nigerian Air Force (NAF) has neutralised key figures of the Islamic State of West Africa Province (ISWAP) in a precision air strike in the Lake Chad region.

key_facts.fact: 被打死者包括ISWAP安全结构及领导委员会成员金杜拉和阿布·基萨
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: those neutralised include key figures within the group’s security structure and leadership council, like Jindullah, the Chief Security Guard and confidant of Abu Saleem, as well as Abul Kissa, a member of ISWAP Shura Council.

key_facts.fact: 空袭摧毁了船只发动机和摩托车等后勤资产
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the strike also destroyed logistical assets including boat engines and motorcycles believed to support the group’s movement and operational activities.

key_facts.fact: 行动在“哈丁凯行动”联合特遣部队框架下针对一处恐怖分子藏身点实施
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the operation was conducted under the Joint Task Force, Operation Hadin Kai (OPHK), on an identified terrorist hideout on Monday.

key_facts.fact: 战果为初步空袭后评估结果，由尼日利亚空军发言人发布
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: preliminary post-strike assessments indicate that several prominent ISWAP fighters were neutralised.

uncertainties: 战果为军方单方面声明，目前仅一个来源，尚未获得独立证实
伤亡人数与具体身份未获独立核实
空袭具体时间与地点细节未明确
